description: Black leather purse with semi-circle (front flap closure) fold-over top and black strap connected by gold rings. Strap has 5 holes and a gold buckle for adjusting. Small unzippered pockets in interior. Shoulder strap has metal buckle with raised center and is secured to purse by circular metal with leather strings that run through "o" rings mounted in the purse, creating folds at its edges.
